steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Cells are the basic building blocks of all living organisms.: In multicellular organisms, cells become specialised for particular functions. Similar cells group together to form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs work together in organ systems.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define the term "tissue." (1 mark) | Describe the hierarchy of organisation in a multicellular organism. (4 marks) | Name the three types of tissue found in the stomach and state the function of each. (3 marks)
